4 اجلى as an intrans. v.: see 1, in two places. ―
-b2- أَجْلَوْ عَنِ القَتِيلِ They cleared themselves away, or removed, from the slain person. (S, Mgh, Msb, TA.) ―
-b3- اجلى يَعْدُو He hastened, running: (K:) or hastened somewhat, running: (TA:) or اجلى signifies he became distant, or remote, and hastened. (So accord. to some copies of the K, where we find وَأَجْلَى بَعُدَ وَ أَسْرَعَ instead of وَ أَجْلَى يَعْدُو أَسْرَعَ.) ＝
-A2- As a trans. v.: see 1, in four places.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
